correctness.rationale: Every normal reduces three translated convex bodies to three equal-length offset intervals whose pairwise intersection implies a common triple intersection. Sorting centers yields exactly-one = exactly-two = width of center triangle and exactly-three = width of body minus triangle width. Cauchy projection formula integrates to perimeters. Explicit 2-disk pair overlap and 3-disk overlap angular integrals yield all three probabilities for every q>0; Taylor expansion at q=sqrt(3)/2 gives the stated positive quadratic coefficient. Independent interval enumeration and high-precision asymptotic checks passed.
